name: European Long distance path E1 - Norway, Hedmark
description_md:
The European Long distance path E1 in Norway is a waymarked hiking route covering 100.5 km in Hedmark. It features 2056 m of ascent and 1754 m of descent, with a walking time of about 30 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This hard route is part of the international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as E1. The geometry matches the official route published by turrutebasen. Walkers will find that the path passes Roros within 100 m, as well as Røros Mining Town and the Circumference within 100 m.
